# @codewithrajat/rm-logvault — full API reference for LLMs

> Offline-first browser error tracking, logging and diagnostics export. IndexedDB-first (write-ahead outbox), optional REST sync with retry/backoff, self-contained XSS-safe HTML/JSON diagnostics report with page-load drill-down on Ctrl+Shift+Alt+D. Zero runtime dependencies. Core 36.55 kB min+gzip (37 kB regression budget). MIT. TypeScript, dual ESM+CJS.

package: @codewithrajat/rm-logvault
version: 1.0.0
engines: node >=18 (tooling only; runtime is browser/worker/SSR-safe)
import specifiers: @codewithrajat/rm-logvault, @codewithrajat/rm-logvault/react, @codewithrajat/rm-logvault/vue, @codewithrajat/rm-logvault/angular, @codewithrajat/rm-logvault/axios, @codewithrajat/rm-logvault/fetch, @codewithrajat/rm-logvault/react-query, @codewithrajat/rm-logvault/http, @codewithrajat/rm-logvault/storage, @codewithrajat/rm-logvault/testing, @codewithrajat/rm-logvault/package.json
optional peers: react>=17, vue>=3, @angular/core>=15, axios>=1, @tanstack/react-query>=4
runtime deps: none
sideEffects: false
type: module
main: dist/index.cjs | module: dist/index.js | types: dist/index.d.ts
size-limit: dist/index.js <= 37 kB min+gzip (measured 36.55 kB, minified+gzipped with all deps)
publishConfig: { access: public, provenance: true }
files: dist, docs, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, LICENSE, llms.txt, llms-full.txt

INVARIANTS
- The public API never throws. Fallible internals return Result<T,R> = {ok:true,value} | {ok:false,reason}.
- initTelemetry and destroyTelemetry are idempotent.
- Every record passes through the sanitizer before storage and before export/upload.
- The core never reads import.meta.env / process.env unless TelemetryOptions.env opts in.
- Transport bodies are already sanitized; a RemoteTransport never sees raw records.
- The default fetch transport is the only network egress, and it is reachable only when
  TelemetryOptions.mode === 'remote'. The default mode is 'local', which issues no requests at all.
  It never reads the response body.
- The diagnostics report never uses innerHTML and makes no network requests.

## 1. QUICK START

initTelemetry({ appName: 'checkout' })
// -> global handlers + IndexedDB persistence (warn+) + Ctrl+Shift+Alt+D HTML report

## 2. ALL DEFAULTS (one table)

TelemetryOptions
  appName: undefined
  appVersion: undefined
  buildId: undefined
  environment: undefined
  enabled: true
  mode: 'local'                 (StorageMode = 'local' | 'remote'. 'local' => ZERO network requests.
                                 Inference: rest.errorsUrl / rest.logsUrl / rest.transport implies
                                 'remote'; none of them implies 'local'; an explicit value always wins;
                                 mode:'local' with a URL stays local. mode:'remote' with no usable
                                 endpoint leaves the uploader disabled and reports the stage
                                 'mode-remote-without-endpoint' once via onInternalError; records are
                                 still kept in IndexedDB, never discarded.)
  dbPrefix: 'rm-logvault'           (produces rm-logvault-errors, rm-logvault-logs)
  openTimeoutMs: 5000           ms to wait for indexedDB.open() before declaring storage unavailable
                                (DEFAULT_OPEN_TIMEOUT_MS, shared with the storage layer)
  env: undefined                (off; true => ['VITE_','NEXT_PUBLIC_','REACT_APP_'])
  errors: ErrorsOptions (see below)
  logs: LogsOptions (see below)
  redaction: RedactionOptions (see below)
  rest: RestOptions (see below)
  shortcut: undefined           (enabled with defaults) | false disables
  consent: undefined
  onInternalError: undefined
  repository: undefined         (IndexedDB)
  logSource: undefined

ErrorsOptions
  enabled: true
  maxRecords: 500               integer, must be > 0
  retentionDays: 7              0 allowed (= no age cutoff)
  maxPayloadBytes: 16384        integer, must be > 0
  maxEventsPerMinute: 120       0 allowed (= unlimited), integer, 60s fixed window
  allowedQueryParams: []        falls through to redaction.allowedQueryParams
  preventDefaultUnhandledRejection: false
  captureResources: false
  captureCsp: false
  captureChunkErrors: true
  beforeCapture: undefined      (record: ErrorRecord) => ErrorRecord | null

LogsOptions
  enabled: true
  level: 'warn'                 PERSIST threshold: trace|debug|info|warn|error|off (none/silent => 'off')
  consoleLevel: undefined       CONSOLE threshold applied at init; undefined => leave the logger's own level.
                                No default on purpose: initTelemetry never changes console output unless asked.
                                destroyTelemetry() resets the console level to 'warn'.
  maxRecords: 2000
  retentionDays: 3
  maxPayloadBytes: 4096
  maxLogsPerMinute: 600
  writeFlushMs: 1000            upper bound on how long a buffered log waits before being written
                                (LOG_FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS); a write also fires at writeBatchSize entries
  writeBatchSize: 50            buffered entries that trigger an immediate write, and the batch size
                                of one IndexedDB transaction (LOG_FLUSH_BATCH_SIZE)
  captureConsole: false         wraps console.warn + console.error only
  beforeStore: undefined        (record: LogRecord) => LogRecord | null

RedactionOptions
  extraSensitiveKeys: []
  extraPatterns: []
  allowedQueryParams: undefined  (undefined => DEFAULT_ALLOWED_QUERY_PARAMS; setting it here OR
                                 under errors sets BOTH; [] means keep NO query values at all,
                                 which is NOT the same as leaving it unset)

RestOptions
  enabled: undefined            derived: true iff transport|errorsUrl|logsUrl supplied, else false
  errorsUrl: undefined
  logsUrl: undefined
  intervalMs: 30000             delay after a successful run
  batchSize: 50
  credentials: 'same-origin'    omit|same-origin|include
  getHeaders: undefined         awaited per request; throwing => retryable
  transport: undefined          default createFetchTransport()
  requireHttps: false
  onTerminalFailure: undefined  (status, records: {id}[]) => void

ShortcutOptions (resolved)
  key: 'd'                      single letter -> Key<X>, digit -> Digit<N>
  ctrl: true
  shift: true
  alt: true
  meta: false
  target: undefined             => document, then the global event target
  allow: undefined              () => boolean; must return literal true
  filenamePrefix: 'diagnostics-report'
  onExported: undefined         (ok: boolean) => void

DiagnosticsExportOptions
  format: 'html'                'html' | 'json'
  copyToClipboard: false
  redactAgain: false
  filenamePrefix: undefined     => shortcut.filenamePrefix, then 'diagnostics-report'
  onExported: undefined

## 3. OPTION PRECEDENCE

explicit option > fromEnv layer > built-in default

env resolution:
  env absent/false/''/[]  -> no env layer
  env true                -> DEFAULT_ENV_PREFIXES = ['VITE_','NEXT_PUBLIC_','REACT_APP_']
  env 'PREFIX_'           -> that prefix only
  env ['A_','B_']         -> those prefixes in order, first non-empty match wins

logs.consoleLevel resolution: logs.consoleLevel ?? LOG_LEVEL ?? undefined (no default)
logs.level resolution:        logs.level ?? LOG_PERSIST_LEVEL ?? TELEMETRY_PERSIST_LEVEL
                              ?? TELEMETRY_LOG_LEVEL ?? LOG_LEVEL (documented inheritance) ?? 'warn'
rest.enabled resolution:      rest.enabled ?? TELEMETRY_REST_ENABLED ?? (transport|errorsUrl|logsUrl ? true : false)
every other numeric:          option ?? its environment variable ?? default
                              (incl. openTimeoutMs ?? TELEMETRY_OPEN_TIMEOUT_MS ?? 5000,
                               logs.writeFlushMs ?? LOG_PERSIST_WRITE_FLUSH_MS ?? 1000,
                               logs.writeBatchSize ?? LOG_PERSIST_WRITE_BATCH_SIZE ?? 50)
mode resolution:              options.mode ?? (rest.enabled ? 'remote' : 'local')
                              (rest.enabled itself defaults to true iff transport|errorsUrl|logsUrl supplied,
                               so configuring URLs and setting rest.enabled:false reports 'local')
syncManager.enabled:          mode === 'remote' AND rest.enabled AND a valid endpoint resolved
                              (an existing endpoint deliberately switched off emits NO mode-remote-without-endpoint note)

INVALID VALUES ARE IGNORED (fall back to the default or the previous value)
  numeric: non-number, NaN, +-Infinity => default. < 1 => default, unless allowZero.
           allowZero is set for errors.retentionDays, errors.maxEventsPerMinute,
           logs.retentionDays, logs.maxLogsPerMinute.
           integer: Math.floor applied for maxRecords, maxPayloadBytes, maxEventsPerMinute,
           logs.maxRecords, logs.maxPayloadBytes, logs.maxLogsPerMinute, rest.intervalMs, rest.batchSize,
           openTimeoutMs, logs.writeFlushMs, logs.writeBatchSize.
           allowZero is NOT set for openTimeoutMs, logs.writeFlushMs or logs.writeBatchSize, so 0 falls
           back to the default (0 would mean "no wait" / "never write", never a useful intent).
  string:  non-string, empty or whitespace-only (after trim) => default.
  arrays:  non-array => []. Entries of the wrong type are filtered out.
  level:   anything outside {trace,debug,info,warn,error,off,none,silent} => ignored (previous kept).
  boolean: non-boolean => default. No string coercion (fromEnv parses 'true'/'1'/'yes'/'on').

## 4. PUBLIC EXPORTS (src/index.ts) — signature :: description

### Lifecycle
initTelemetry(options?: TelemetryOptions): TelemetryHandle :: bootstrap; idempotent; never throws; second call returns the existing handle and installs nothing.
destroyTelemetry(): void :: remove listeners+timers synchronously, then flush and close DBs async; idempotent; never throws.
flushTelemetry(): Promise<void> :: wait for buffered writes and the pending-count snapshot; never rejects; does not upload.
syncTelemetry(): Promise<FlushResult> :: flush then force one upload run; never rejects; concurrent calls share a run.
retryFailedTelemetry(): Promise<number> :: move terminally-failed records back to pending, clear backoff, schedule immediately; returns how many moved.
clearTelemetryData(): Promise<boolean> :: wipe every row in both stores; clears the pre-init buffer; true only if both clears succeeded; false if no repository.
getTelemetryStatus(): TelemetryStatus :: synchronous snapshot; never throws.
isTelemetryInitialized(): boolean :: whether initTelemetry completed and has not been destroyed.

TelemetryHandle = { appName: string|undefined; pageLoadId: string; enabled: boolean; storage: StorageState; destroy(): void; flush(): Promise<void>; sync(): Promise<FlushResult> }
TelemetryStatus = { initialized: boolean; mode: 'local'|'remote'; storage: 'initializing'|'ready'|'unavailable'|'disabled'; online: boolean; pending: {errors: number; logs: number}; droppedByRateLimit: number; lastSync: number|undefined; syncStatus: SyncStatus }
SyncStatus = 'idle'|'running'|'offline'|'ok'|'retry'|'error'
FlushResult = { errors: FlushSummary; logs: FlushSummary }
FlushSummary = { claimed: number; uploaded: number; retried: number; failed: number; stopped: boolean }

### Configuration
resolveOptions(options?: TelemetryOptions): ResolvedTelemetryOptions :: resolve+validate+freeze; precedence applied; invalid numerics/levels ignored.
databaseNames(dbPrefix: string): { errors: string; logs: string } :: `${dbPrefix}-errors`, `${dbPrefix}-logs`.
DEFAULT_OPTIONS :: { enabled: true, dbPrefix: 'rm-logvault', errors: {...}, logs: {...}, rest: {...} } (see §2).
Exported option types: TelemetryOptions, ErrorsOptions, LogsOptions, RedactionOptions, RestOptions, ShortcutOptions, ResolvedTelemetryOptions, ResolvedErrorsOptions, ResolvedLogsOptions, ResolvedRedactionOptions, ResolvedRestOptions, ResolvedShortcutOptions.

### Environment
fromEnv(prefix?: string | readonly string[]): EnvOptions :: build options from env vars; never throws.
DEFAULT_ENV_PREFIXES: readonly string[] = ['VITE_','NEXT_PUBLIC_','REACT_APP_']
isBrowser(): boolean :: window and document both present.
getGlobal(key: string): unknown :: read from globalThis without throwing.
safeGet(target: unknown, key: string): unknown :: read a property without triggering hostile getters.
EnvOptions = { appName?, appVersion?, buildId?, environment?, enabled?, dbPrefix?, openTimeoutMs?,
  errorsEnabled?, errorsRetentionDays?, errorsMaxRecords?, errorsMaxPayloadBytes?, errorsMaxEventsPerMinute?,
  logsEnabled?, consoleLevel?, persistLevel?, logLevel?, logsRetentionDays?, logsMaxRecords?,
  logsMaxPayloadBytes?, logsMaxLogsPerMinute?, logsWriteFlushMs?, logsWriteBatchSize?,
  restEnabled?, errorsUrl?, logsUrl?, restIntervalMs?, restBatchSize? }

Env var suffixes (prefixed by VITE_ | NEXT_PUBLIC_ | REACT_APP_):
  APP_NAME->appName, APP_VERSION->appVersion, BUILD_ID->buildId,
  APP_ENV->environment (fallback ENVIRONMENT), TELEMETRY_ENABLED->enabled,
  TELEMETRY_DB_PREFIX->dbPrefix, TELEMETRY_OPEN_TIMEOUT_MS->openTimeoutMs,
  ERROR_TRACKING_ENABLED->errorsEnabled, ERROR_TRACKING_RETENTION_DAYS->errorsRetentionDays,
  ERROR_TRACKING_MAX_RECORDS->errorsMaxRecords, ERROR_TRACKING_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES->errorsMaxPayloadBytes,
  ERROR_TRACKING_MAX_EVENTS_PER_MINUTE->errorsMaxEventsPerMinute,
  LOG_PERSIST_ENABLED->logsEnabled, LOG_LEVEL->consoleLevel, LOG_PERSIST_LEVEL->persistLevel,
  LOG_PERSIST_RETENTION_DAYS->logsRetentionDays, LOG_PERSIST_MAX_RECORDS->logsMaxRecords,
  LOG_PERSIST_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES->logsMaxPayloadBytes,
  LOG_PERSIST_MAX_LOGS_PER_MINUTE->logsMaxLogsPerMinute,
  LOG_PERSIST_WRITE_FLUSH_MS->logsWriteFlushMs, LOG_PERSIST_WRITE_BATCH_SIZE->logsWriteBatchSize,
  ERROR_TRACKING_REST_URL->errorsUrl, LOG_TRACKING_REST_URL->logsUrl,
  TELEMETRY_REST_ENABLED->restEnabled, TELEMETRY_SYNC_INTERVAL_MS->restIntervalMs,
  TELEMETRY_SYNC_BATCH_SIZE->restBatchSize
legacy aliases (still read; the specific name wins when both are set):
  TELEMETRY_ERRORS_ENABLED->errorsEnabled, TELEMETRY_LOGS_ENABLED->logsEnabled,
  TELEMETRY_PERSIST_LEVEL->persistLevel, TELEMETRY_LOG_LEVEL->logLevel (PERSIST only, never console),
  TELEMETRY_ERRORS_URL->errorsUrl, TELEMETRY_LOGS_URL->logsUrl
env parsing: absent/empty/whitespace == not set. number: non-number, NaN, Infinity or negative => undefined
  (the option then falls back to its default); 0 is preserved; integers are floored except retentionDays
  (fractional days allowed, 0.5 == 12h). An empty LOG_PERSIST_LEVEL therefore inherits LOG_LEVEL.
Booleans: true/1/yes/on and false/0/no/off, trimmed + lowercased; anything else ignored.

### Logger
logger: Logger :: the shared facade.
createLogger(): LoggerController :: isolated controller (logger, replayPreInit, bufferedCount, setConsoleCapture, emitInternal, reset).
Logger = { trace|debug|info|warn|error(message: string, ...args: readonly unknown[]): void; addSink(sink: LogSink): () => void; setLevel(level: LogLevelSetting): void; setEnabled(enabled: boolean): void; getConfig(): {level: LogLevelSetting; enabled: boolean} }
LogSink = { name?: string|undefined; write(record: LogRecord): void }
LogLevel = 'trace'|'debug'|'info'|'warn'|'error'
LogLevelSetting = LogLevel | 'off'
LOG_LEVELS = ['trace','debug','info','warn','error']
LOG_LEVEL_PRIORITY = { trace:10, debug:20, info:30, warn:40, error:50 }
levelPriority(level: LogLevelSetting): number :: 'off' => Infinity.
meetsLevel(actual: LogLevel, threshold: LogLevelSetting): boolean :: false when threshold==='off'.

Record routing: the destination depends on the API called, NOT the level. logger.* and captured console.* produce a LogRecord -> `${dbPrefix}-logs` store 'logs', at every level (logger.error is a LOG record with level 'error'). Only captureError, the framework adapters and the global handlers produce an ErrorRecord -> `${dbPrefix}-errors` store 'errors'. The two are not interchangeable: ErrorRecord carries fingerprint/severity/category/handled/occurrenceCount/firstSeen/lastSeen and aggregates repeats into one pending row, while LogRecord carries level/message/data/route/seq and is appended one row per call.
Log call shape: logger.<level>(message, ...args). message is scrubbed as free text and capped at MAX_LOG_MESSAGE_LENGTH (1000); up to MAX_LOG_ARGS (5) args are deep-scrubbed by sanitizeValue and stored as the record's `data` array.
A message starting with a RESERVED_LOG_PREFIXES entry ('[ErrorTracking]'|'[LogTracking]'|'[Telemetry]'|'[DiagnosticsExport]') is never persisted — console only, by design.
undefined and null both store as null, so a missing property is indistinguishable from an explicit null; encode the difference explicitly if it matters.
A function stores as the literal '[Function]'; log fn.name instead. A sensitive key (SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN) stores '[REDACTED]' regardless of value.
Oversize log records are reduced in this order: drop `data`, then shorten `message` to 300 chars (LOG_REDUCED_MESSAGE_LENGTH), then drop the record. Default budget logs.maxPayloadBytes = 4096.
Value caps inside one record: MAX_DEPTH 4 -> '[MaxDepth]', MAX_KEYS 30 -> '…' overflow entry, MAX_ARRAY_ITEMS 20 -> '[+N]', MAX_STRING_LENGTH 2000 truncated with length suffix, cycle -> '[Circular]'.

### Error capture
captureError(error: unknown, ctx?: ErrorContext): void :: the single ingestion point; never throws; pre-init buffered (50).
captureApiError(error: unknown, startedAt?: number): void :: axios-shaped failure; source 'api'; allow-listed fields only.
captureFetchError(request: FetchRequestInfo, failure: FetchFailure): void :: failed fetch; source 'api'.
withErrorCapture<T>(handler: () => T, ctx?: ErrorContext): T :: capture then re-throw the SAME value; default source 'event-handler'.
Types: ErrorContext, ErrorRecord, ErrorSource, ErrorSeverity, ErrorCategory, ApiErrorContext, ApiErrorKind, ErrorCause, ErrorLocation, ThrownType.

ErrorSource = 'react'|'vue'|'angular'|'svelte'|'api'|'window'|'unhandledrejection'|'resource'|'chunk'|'csp'|'event-handler'|'worker'|'query'|'storage'|'manual'
ErrorSeverity = 'fatal'|'error'|'warning'|'info'
ErrorCategory = 'runtime'|'chunk'|'resource'|'http'|'network'|'timeout'|'abort'|'parse'|'auth'|'security'
ThrownType = 'error'|'string'|'number'|'boolean'|'object'|'null'|'undefined'|'other'
ApiErrorKind = 'auth'|'abort'|'timeout'|'parse'|'http'|'network'|'unknown'

Adapter captures are ERROR records. Every @codewithrajat/rm-logvault/<framework> adapter funnels into captureError, so its output is written to `${dbPrefix}-errors` store 'errors' with that adapter's source ('react'|'vue'|'angular'|'query'), never to the logs store.
A throw handled by a framework ErrorHandler and a logger.* call are independent records: the throw neither suppresses the earlier call nor carries it, and an ErrorRecord contains no breadcrumb of preceding logs. Attach context with ctx.tags / ctx.extra at the capture site.
console.warn/console.error are captured only when logs.captureConsole is true; console.log/console.info never are.
logger.setLevel sets console verbosity only; logs.level (default 'warn') is the independent persist threshold.
Known defect, 1.0.0 only, fixed in 1.0.1: every adapter subpath bundle inlined the core, so its copy of captureError held a tracker that could never be installed (setErrorTracker is reachable only from initTelemetry, in the root entry). Rollup compiled the dispatch away, so everything captured through a subpath adapter was buffered and discarded with no [Telemetry] output — failing without failing anything. captureError imported from the root entry was unaffected. See DECISIONS.md D-026.
A failed error-record write is reported through reportInternalFailure stage 'error-persist' (reason is the StorageFailureReason: 'unavailable'|'quota'|'serialization'|'transaction'). The log tracker's equivalent stage is 'persist'. Each stage is emitted once per initialization, which is why they are named separately. A store that opened and then refused a write leaves getTelemetryStatus().storage reading 'ready' — the 'error-persist' line is the only signal.

### Normalisation / classification / fingerprint
normalizeError(input: unknown): NormalizedError :: anything -> NormalizedError; never throws; fallback UNNORMALIZABLE.
sanitizeNormalized(normalized: NormalizedError): NormalizedError :: re-scrub an already-normalised value.
UNNORMALIZABLE: NormalizedError = { name:'Error', message:'Unnormalizable error value', thrownType:'other', isChunkError:false, isCrossOrigin:false, category:'runtime' }
buildApiErrorContext(error: unknown, startedAt?: number): ApiClassification :: kind order auth>abort>timeout>parse>http>network>unknown.
buildFetchErrorContext(request: FetchRequestInfo, failure: FetchFailure): ApiClassification :: status 0 or absent response => 'network'.
categoryForKind(kind: ApiErrorKind): ErrorCategory
severityForKind(kind: ApiErrorKind, status: number|undefined): ErrorSeverity :: abort=>info, auth=>warning, http<500=>warning, else error.
markAuthError<T>(error: T): T :: tags the error with the non-enumerable flag _isTokenFetchError; returns the same object.
isAuthError(error: unknown): boolean
CORRELATION_HEADERS = ['x-request-id','x-correlation-id','x-trace-id','traceparent']
FingerprintInput = { source; category; name; message; stack?; componentStack?; route?; api?: Pick<ApiErrorContext,'kind'|'method'|'url'|'status'>; event?: Pick<ErrorEventInfo,'type'|'resourceUrl'|'directive'>; location? }
fetch request/failure: FetchRequestInfo = { method?; url?; startedAt? }; FetchFailure = { error?; response?; timedOut? }
ApiClassification = { api: ApiErrorContext; category: ErrorCategory; severity: ErrorSeverity }

### Fingerprinting
fingerprint(input: FingerprintInput): string :: 28 lowercase hex chars (2x cyrb53 with seeds 1 and 2); 'unfingerprinted-...' on failure.
fingerprintParts(input: FingerprintInput): string[] :: ordered parts: source, category, name, message, top5 stack frames, top3 component frames, normalised route, api(kind,method,url,status), event(type,resourceUrl,directive), location (only when no stack).
normalizePathForFingerprint(input: string|undefined): string :: drop query+fragment; numeric/UUID/long-hex segments -> ':id'.
topStackFrames(stack: string|undefined, count: number): string :: frames joined with '|'; recognises 'at ' and 'fn@url'.
cyrb53(input: string, seed?: number): number :: 53-bit hash in [0, 2^53).
FINGERPRINT_STACK_FRAMES = 5; FINGERPRINT_COMPONENT_FRAMES = 3 (internal)

### Sanitisation
createSanitizer(config?: SanitizerConfig): Sanitizer :: never throws; fails closed.
sanitizeText(input: unknown, maxLength?: number): string :: default 2000; returns '[REDACTED]' on failure.
sanitizeUrl(input: unknown, maxLength?: number): string|undefined :: default 2000; undefined for non-string/empty.
sanitizeStack(input: unknown, maxLength?: number): string :: default 8000; drops Vite ?t=/?v= cache busters first.
sanitizeValue(input: unknown, key?: string): unknown :: bounded deep scrub; JSON-safe; never throws.
isSensitiveKey(key: string): boolean :: fails closed (true) if the check throws.
getDefaultSanitizer(): Sanitizer :: the sanitizer in force (replaced by initTelemetry from options.redaction).
SanitizerConfig = { extraSensitiveKeys?: readonly (string|RegExp)[]; extraPatterns?: readonly RegExp[]; allowedQueryParams?: readonly string[] }
Sanitizer = { text(input, maxLength?): string; stack(input, maxLength?): string; url(input, maxLength?): string|undefined; value(input, key?): unknown; isSensitiveKey(key: string): boolean }

sanitizeValue output for special values:
  null -> null; undefined -> null; function -> '[Function]'; symbol -> String(sym); bigint -> String(v)
  non-finite number -> String(v); Date -> ISO string or 'Invalid Date'
  Error-like -> { name, message } (both scrubbed)
  Event -> '[Event <type>]'; Element -> '[Element <tag>]'
  cycle -> '[Circular]'; depth > 4 -> '[MaxDepth]'
  keys > 30 -> extra '…' key with '[+N keys]'; array/Set > 20 -> extra '[+N]'
  unreadable property -> '[Unserializable]'; whole-walk failure -> '[Unserializable]'
  keys __proto__, constructor, prototype are skipped
  objects built with Object.fromEntries (own data properties; prototype-pollution safe)

### Constants (exported)
REDACTED = '[REDACTED]'
SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN = /(authorization|cookie|token|password|passwd|pwd|secret|apikey|accesskey|privatekey|credential|session|signature|bearer|otp|^auth$|email|phone)/
  matched against key.toLowerCase().replace(/[-_\s]/g,'')
DEFAULT_ALLOWED_QUERY_PARAMS = ['limit','offset','page','pageSize','size','sort','order','scope','lng','lang','type']
MAX_DEPTH = 4
MAX_KEYS = 30
MAX_ARRAY_ITEMS = 20
MAX_STRING_LENGTH = 2000
MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH = 1000
MAX_STACK_LENGTH = 8000
MAX_COMPONENT_STACK_LENGTH = 4000
MAX_CAUSE_DEPTH = 3
MAX_TAGS = 20
MAX_LOG_ARGS = 5
UNHANDLED_SOURCES = Set{'window','unhandledrejection','resource','chunk','csp','worker'}  (handled = !has(source))

### Global handlers
installGlobalErrorHandlers(options: GlobalHandlerOptions): () => void :: chained onerror + unhandledrejection + vite:preloadError; optional resource (capture phase) and CSP; merges registrations.
globalHandlerCount(): number
globalHandlersAttached(): boolean
GlobalHandlerOptions = { onError(error: unknown, ctx: ErrorContext): void; preventDefaultUnhandledRejection?: boolean; captureResources?: boolean; captureCsp?: boolean; captureChunkErrors?: boolean }

### Diagnostics export
exportDiagnosticsReport(options?: DiagnosticsExportOptions): Promise<DiagnosticsExportResult> :: flush, read ALL records, render, download or copy; never rejects.
  DiagnosticsExportResult = { ok: boolean; format: DiagnosticsFormat; bytes: number }
  BREAKING (was Promise<boolean>): `if (await exportDiagnosticsReport())` still works, since the object is truthy.
  ok is false outside a browser, with no repository, or on a concurrent call (the in-flight guard).
  DiagnosticsExportOptions = { format?: 'html'|'json'|'jsonl'|'csv' = 'html'; copyToClipboard?; pretty?: boolean = false;
                                redactAgain?; filenamePrefix?; onProgress?: (processed, total) => void; onExported?: (ok) => void }
  'pretty' applies to 'json' ONLY — it is ignored by 'jsonl', where an indented object would break one-record-per-line.
  onProgress fires once per EXPORT_SLICE_SIZE records and once at the end; a throwing callback is contained.
  'jsonl' emits `{"kind":"error",...}` / `{"kind":"log",...}`, one compact object per line, '\n' separated.
  'csv' emits ONE table for both kinds, distinguished by a leading `kind` column, CRLF line endings, RFC 4180 quoting.
    FORMULA INJECTION IS NEUTRALISED: a cell starting with = + - @, tab or CR is prefixed with an apostrophe, because
    Excel/Sheets/LibreOffice execute such a cell on open and an error message is attacker-influenced input.
installDiagnosticsExportShortcut(options?: DiagnosticsShortcutOptions | false): () => void
installShortcut(config: Partial<ShortcutConfig>|undefined, onTrigger: () => void): () => void :: capture-phase keydown listener; returns cleanup.
matchesShortcut(event: KeyboardEvent, config: ShortcutConfig): boolean :: exact modifier match; code first, key fallback.
expectedCode(key: string): string|undefined :: 'd'->'KeyD', '7'->'Digit7', else undefined.
isEditableTarget(target: EventTarget|null|undefined): boolean :: input/textarea/select/contenteditable.
isExportInFlight(): boolean :: in-flight guard.
diagnosticsFilename(prefix: string, extension: string): string :: `${prefix}-${ISO with : and . replaced by -}.${extension}`
renderDiagnosticsReport(meta: ReportMeta, errors, logs, encodedPayload?: string): string :: complete self-contained HTML.
buildReportPayload(meta, errors, logs): ReportPayload
escapeHtml(value: string): string :: & < > " '
escapeJsonText(json: string): string :: < > & U+2028 U+2029 -> \uXXXX
encodeJsonForHtml(value: unknown): string :: JSON.stringify then escapeJsonText; unstringifiable -> 'null'.
REPORT_PRIVACY_BANNER = 'This report may contain personal data (page URLs, browser details, application messages). Review before sharing.'
sanitizeErrorRecord(record: ErrorRecord): ErrorRecord :: second-pass redaction; returns the record unchanged if it throws.
sanitizeLogRecord(record: LogRecord): LogRecord :: same.
DiagnosticsFormat = 'html' | 'json' | 'jsonl' | 'csv'
DIAGNOSTICS_CSV_COLUMNS = ['kind','id','timestamp','severity','source','category','name','message','occurrenceCount','fingerprint','route','method','url','status']
  Errors and logs share these columns and leave the inapplicable ones empty, so the file can be sorted and pivoted in one sheet.
DiagnosticsShortcutOptions = Partial<ShortcutConfig> & { filenamePrefix?; exportOptions?: DiagnosticsExportOptions; onExported? }
ShortcutConfig = { key: string; ctrl: boolean; shift: boolean; alt: boolean; meta: boolean; target?: EventTarget; allow?: () => boolean }
ReportMeta = { generatedAt: string; appName: string; appVersion: string; buildId: string; environment: string; url: string; userAgent: string; online: boolean; errorCount: number; logCount: number }
ReportPayload = { schemaVersion: number; generatedAt: string; app: {appName,appVersion,buildId,environment}; page: {url,userAgent,online}; errors: ErrorRecord[]; logs: LogRecord[] }
EXPORT_SLICE_SIZE = 500

### Events (observation)
createEventEmitter(): EventEmitter :: a fresh emitter. initTelemetry exposes one as handle.events.
  handle.events is a STABLE wrapper, not the per-installation emitter: the same object is returned by every
  initTelemetry call, so a reference captured once keeps observing across a destroy/re-init cycle. Before init and
  after teardown, subscriptions land on a dormant emitter, so a listener registered at module load is not lost.
  TelemetryEventType = 'error:captured' | 'log:written' | 'sync:started' | 'sync:completed' | 'sync:failed' | 'record:dropped'
  EventEmitter = { on(type, listener): () => void; onAny(listener): () => void; off(type, listener): void;
                   emit(event): void; listenerCount(type?): number; clear(): void }
  Every listener runs in its own try/catch, so a throwing subscriber cannot stop the capture that notified it.
  An async listener's rejection is observed and routed to reportInternalFailure — never an unhandled rejection.
  Nested emission (a listener that emits) is QUEUED, not recursed, and the drain replaces the pending slot rather
  than appending, so a listener that emits on every event terminates instead of spinning.
  Payloads: ErrorCapturedEvent { recordId, fingerprint, severity, source, category, handled, occurrenceCount }
            LogWrittenEvent { recordId, level, message }   (message is ALREADY sanitized)
            SyncStartedEvent { kind, recordCount }         SyncCompletedEvent { kind, uploaded, retried, failed }
            SyncFailedEvent { kind, status, recordCount }  RecordDroppedEvent { kind, reason, count }
  HONEST SCOPE: these report captureError and logger activity plus explicit syncTelemetry() runs. The automatic
  background flush is internal and does NOT emit sync:started / sync:completed. destroyTelemetry clears listeners.

### Error context builders (extension)
registerErrorContextBuilder(builder: ErrorContextBuilder): () => void :: register; a duplicate `name` REPLACES the previous one.
unregisterErrorContextBuilder(name: string): boolean
clearErrorContextBuilders(): void :: intended for tests and for swapping classification wholesale.
listErrorContextBuilders(): readonly ErrorContextBuilder[]  ;  errorContextBuilderCount(): number
resolveErrorContext(error: unknown, ctx?: ErrorContext): ErrorContext :: never throws; returns ctx ?? {} when nothing is registered.
ErrorContextBuilder = { name: string; canHandle(error, ctx?): boolean; build(error, ctx?): ErrorContext | null }
  Resolution is REGISTRATION ORDER and the first match wins; register specific classifiers before general ones.
  MERGE RULE: the caller's explicit fields ALWAYS beat the builder's — a builder cannot override source on an explicit
  captureError(err, { source: 'react' }). `tags` and `extra` are the exception: they merge KEY-BY-KEY with the caller
  winning on a conflict, because those two are additive by nature and discarding either would lose information silently.
  The registry is PROCESS-WIDE and SURVIVES destroyTelemetry: it describes the application, not an installation.
  A throwing canHandle counts as "no match"; a throwing build falls through to the next builder.
  captureError applies builders before building the record, so a builder-supplied category/severity/tag is
  indistinguishable in the output from one the caller passed.
installBuiltinContextBuilders(): () => void :: registers timeout -> http -> type-error, and returns ONE unregister fn.
httpErrorContextBuilder | timeoutErrorContextBuilder | typeErrorContextBuilder
  NOTHING SELF-REGISTERS. Importing the module has no effect, so upgrading the library cannot silently reclassify
  an existing application's errors. Order matters: `timeout` is first because a timed-out request can also look like
  an HTTP failure and 'timeout' is the more useful label; `type-error` is last so it cannot shadow either.
  timeout matches code ETIMEDOUT/ECONNABORTED or a timeout-shaped message.
  http matches a response object with a numeric status, or a numeric status/statusCode. Reads only the allow-list.
  type-error matches a TypeError, including cross-realm ones (checked by constructor name).

### Logger sinks
getSinkRegistry(): SinkRegistry :: the registry behind the module-level `logger`. Inspection and keyed removal only.
createSinkRegistry(): SinkRegistry
SinkRegistry = { register(key, sink): () => void; unregister(key): boolean; get(key): LogSink | undefined; has(key): boolean;
                 list(): readonly SinkRegistration[]; keys(): readonly string[]; size(): number; write(record): void; clear(): void }
SinkRegistration = { key: string; name: string | undefined; sink: LogSink }
  logger.addSink(sink) remains THE installation API; registering directly in the registry would bypass pre-init
  replay and the re-entrancy guard. addSink generates the key `${sink.name ?? 'sink'}#${n}` — the sequence suffix is
  what keeps two sinks that declare the same name from replacing each other. Re-registering an existing key replaces
  that sink and returns a fresh unsubscribe fn; an older unsubscribe fn is safe to call and does not remove the replacement.

### Adapter descriptors
ADAPTERS: readonly AdapterDescriptor[] :: a FROZEN CONSTANT, not a runtime registry. 9 entries; key/framework/entryPoint/inCore/targets/exports/description/kind.
adapterFor(key: string): AdapterDescriptor | undefined  ;  adapterFrameworks(): readonly string[]  (sorted, includes 'core')
AdapterKind = 'framework' | 'http-client' | 'storage' | 'transport'
  A runtime self-registering Map was REJECTED: it reports [] for every adapter the application did not happen to
  import, so it answers the question wrong in the common case, and it costs bundle size for build-time-constant
  information. ADAPTERS is annotated /* @__PURE__ */ so it tree-shakes away when unread — load-bearing, because its
  `framework` fields are the literal strings 'react', 'vue' and 'axios' and without the annotation the
  size:consumers peer tripwire reports bundled peers that were never bundled.

### Storage
createErrorRepository(options: ErrorRepositoryOptions): ErrorRepository :: IndexedDB-backed; construction never opens the DB.
createLogRepository(options: LogRepositoryOptions): LogRepository
createDbConnection(options: IdbCoreOptions): DbConnection
classifyStorageError(error: unknown): StorageFailureReason :: quota | serialization | transaction.
promisifyRequest<T>(request: IDBRequest<T>): Promise<T>
isErrorRecord(value: unknown): value is ErrorRecord
isLogRecord(value: unknown): value is LogRecord
ErrorRepositoryOptions = { dbName: string; indexedDB?: IDBFactory; onFailure?: (reason, error) => void; cleanupPolicy?: CleanupPolicy; cleanupEveryWrites?: number; openTimeoutMs?: number }
IdbCoreOptions = { dbName; version; storeName; upgrade(db, oldVersion, tx): void; openTimeoutMs?; indexedDB?; onFailure? }
DbConnection = { dbName; storeName; version; isOpen(): boolean; ensureOpen(); transaction(mode, work); deleteDatabase(); close() }
CleanupPolicy = { retentionDays: number; maxRecords: number }
StorageFailureReason = 'unavailable'|'quota'|'serialization'|'transaction'
StorageResult<T> = Result<T, StorageFailureReason>
StorageState = 'initializing'|'ready'|'unavailable'|'disabled'
  'initializing' = initTelemetry returned but the IndexedDB readiness promise has not settled;
  await flushTelemetry() settles it.
ErrorRepository: initialize, save(record), get(id), getAll(), getPending(limit?), claimPending(limit, now), requeueStale(olderThanMs, now), getFailed(), delete(ids), updateUploadStatus(ids, status), count(), pendingCount(), cleanup(policy), clear(), close()
LogRepository: same, with saveBatch(records) instead of save(record)
TelemetryRepository = { errors: ErrorRepository; logs: LogRepository; initialize(); close() }
pendingCount() counts 'pending' PLUS 'uploading'.

### Sync
createSyncManager(options: SyncManagerOptions): SyncManager
createFetchTransport(options?: FetchTransportOptions): RemoteTransport :: the only network egress.
resolveEndpoint(raw: string|undefined, requireHttps: boolean): string|undefined
resolveEndpoints(options: ResolvedTelemetryOptions): { errorsUrl: string|undefined; logsUrl: string|undefined }

TERMINAL_STATUSES = Set{400,401,403,404,405,410,413,415,422}

ResponseOutcome = 'ok'|'terminal'|'retryable'
RecordKind = 'errors'|'logs'

### Payload budgeting
byteLength(value: unknown): number :: UTF-8 bytes of JSON.stringify; Infinity when unserialisable.

## 5. SUBPATH ADAPTERS

@codewithrajat/rm-logvault/react
  TelemetryErrorBoundary (class extends Component) props: { children?; fallback?: ReactNode | ((error: Error, reset: () => void) => ReactNode); onError?: (error, info) => void; context?: ErrorContext }
  reactRootErrorHandlers(context?: ErrorContext): ReactRootErrorHandlers
    onUncaughtError -> source 'react', severity 'fatal', componentStack
    onCaughtError   -> source 'react', handled true, componentStack
    onRecoverableError -> source 'react', severity 'warning', handled true, tags.recoverable='true'
  useErrorCapture(context?: ErrorContext): (error: unknown, extra?: ErrorContext) => void
  All three funnel into captureError; identity dedup prevents double records.

@codewithrajat/rm-logvault/vue
  attachVueTelemetry(app: App, options?: { context?: ErrorContext; captureWarnings?: boolean = true }): void
    chains app.config.errorHandler (extra.vueInfo = Vue's info string) and app.config.warnHandler (severity 'warning', handled true, tags {framework:'vue', kind:'warning'}, extra.vueTrace).
  createTelemetryVuePlugin(options?): { install(app: App): void }

@codewithrajat/rm-logvault/angular
  TelemetryErrorHandler implements ErrorHandler { constructor(context?: ErrorContext); handleError(error: unknown): void }  -> captures then delegates to console.error.
  provideTelemetryErrorHandler(context?: ErrorContext): Provider  -> { provide: ErrorHandler, useFactory: () => new TelemetryErrorHandler(context) }  (useFactory, so no decorator-metadata flags needed)
  getPreviousErrorHandler(injector: { get(token, notFoundValue?): unknown }): ErrorHandler | undefined

@codewithrajat/rm-logvault/axios
  attachAxios(instance: AxiosInstance): () => void
    response interceptor; reads method,url,status,statusText,code,timeout,duration,first correlation header; re-throws the original rejection unchanged.
    startedAt = Date.now() - (config.timeout ?? 0) when timeout > 0, else undefined.

    wraps globalThis.fetch; never reads bodies; returns the original Response; skips the library's own endpoints.
  registerTelemetryUrl(url: string): () => void

    chains QueryCache.config.onError and MutationCache.config.onError; source 'query', category 'network', tags {kind:'query'|'mutation', queryKey|mutationKey}.

@codewithrajat/rm-logvault/testing
  createMemoryRepository(options?: { failWith?: StorageFailureReason; quotaAt?: number }): MemoryRepository
    Adds errors.all(), logs.all(), errors.reset(), logs.reset(), reset(). Mirrors IndexedDB semantics exactly.
  createFakeTransport(options?: { status?: number | ((request, index) => number); retryAfterMs?: number; failTimes?: number; onSend?: (request, index) => void }): FakeTransport
    Adds requests, sendCount, lastBody(), reset(). Default status 202. failTimes rejects (transport failure). A throwing status function yields 500.

@codewithrajat/rm-logvault/http
  The HTTP client contract and its fetch implementation. NOTE: this is the ONE public surface that
  may reject by design (an HTTP client that cannot report a failure is useless). Nothing in
  core/errors/storage/sync/export imports it, so the never-throw guarantee elsewhere is unaffected.
  Types: HttpClient, HttpClientOptions, HttpError, NonRetryableHttpError, HttpInterceptor, HttpMethod,
         HttpRequest, HttpResponse, AuthProvider, AuthHeaderProvider, AuthHeaderProviderOptions
  createFetchHttpClient(options?: HttpClientOptions): HttpClient
    options: baseUrl; timeoutMs = 30000 (per ATTEMPT, not per call); headers; getHeaders?: () => Record<string,string> | Promise<...>
             (awaited per request, merged LAST so a rotated token wins); bodyMode 'json'|'text'|'raw' = 'json';
             readAs 'auto'|'json'|'text'|'arrayBuffer'|'blob'|'none' = 'auto' ('none' never reads the body);
             credentials = 'same-origin'; retry = 0; retryDelayMs = 300; rejectOnHttpError = true;
             onError?: (error: HttpError, context: ErrorContext) => void; fetchImpl?: typeof fetch
    HttpClient methods: request<T>(req); get/post/put/patch/delete(url, body?, opts?); setInterceptors(list); getInterceptors()
    Retry attempts = 1 + retry. Retried statuses: 0, 408, 429, all 5xx. Backoff min(base * 2^(n-1), 30000).
    HttpError: extends Error, name 'HttpError'; request; response?; isNetworkError; isTimeout; isAbort; statusCode (0 = no response); attempts.
  NonRetryableHttpError extends HttpError with isRetryable: false — set for a deterministic failure (a throwing
    getHeaders provider, an unserialisable body), which createFetchHttpClient therefore does not retry.
    onError runs BEFORE the rejection and receives buildHttpErrorContext(error); a throwing onError is contained.
  createAuthHeaderProvider(provider: AuthProvider, options?: AuthHeaderProviderOptions): AuthHeaderProvider
    AuthProvider: getToken(): string | undefined | Promise<...>; refreshToken?(): Promise<string | undefined>;
                  isTokenExpired?(token): boolean; onUnauthorized?(): void | Promise<void>; logout?(): void | Promise<void>
    options: headerName = 'Authorization'; scheme = 'Bearer ' (set '' for a bare API key); getExtraHeaders?
    Returns { getHeaders(): Promise<Record<string,string>>, refresh(): Promise<string | undefined> }. Never rejects.
    Concurrent refresh() calls share ONE in-flight attempt (single-flight).
    onUnauthorized is NOT called when there is simply no token (the normal anonymous path); it IS called when a
    present token was stale and could not be refreshed.
  createAuthInterceptor(provider: AuthProvider): HttpInterceptor
    name 'auth'. onRequest merges the provider's headers under the per-request ones. onError on a 401 attempts ONE
    refresh, then logout() + onUnauthorized() if it failed. It does NOT re-issue the request.
  buildHttpErrorContext(error: HttpError): ErrorContext  -> { source: 'api', category, severity, api, tags }
  categoryForHttpStatus(status, timedOut): 'auth'|'timeout'|'network'|'http'|'abort'  (401/403/407 auth; 408/504 timeout; 0 network)
  severityForHttpError(status, timedOut): 'error' (timedOut or 0 or 5xx) | 'warning' (other 4xx)
  isRetryableStatus(status): boolean   (0, 408, 429, 5xx)
  resolveRequestUrl(url, baseUrl): string   ; DEFAULT_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS = 30000 ; DEFAULT_HTTP_RETRY_DELAY_MS = 300

@codewithrajat/rm-logvault/storage
  Encryption adapters plus a repository wrapper. Re-exports CleanupPolicy and StorageFailureReason.
  Types: EncryptionProvider { encrypt(plaintext): string | Promise<string>; decrypt(stored): string | Promise<string>; name? }
         EncryptableRepository<T> { getAll; get; save; saveBatch?; claimPending?; getFailed?; pendingCount?; updateUploadStatus? }
         EncryptingRepository<T> = EncryptableRepository<T> & { inner; provider }
         EncryptingRepositoryOptions { fields: readonly string[]; onDecryptFailure?: (field, error) => void }
         AesGcmEncryptionProviderOptions { password: string; salt: Uint8Array; iterations? = 250000 }
  createEncryptingRepository<T>(inner, provider, options): EncryptingRepository<T>
    fields accepts 'message' or a dotted path 'api.url'. save/saveBatch encrypt; get/getAll/claimPending/getFailed decrypt;
    pendingCount and updateUploadStatus pass through untouched (they key on id/fingerprint/uploadStatus, which encryption would break).
    A field that fails to decrypt KEEPS ITS STORED VALUE rather than being blanked, and onDecryptFailure is called.
    A field whose encryption fails is written in PLAINTEXT rather than lost.
  createBase64EncryptionProvider(): EncryptionProvider
    ENCODING, NOT ENCRYPTION. btoa(encodeURIComponent(x)) / decodeURIComponent(atob(x)). Falls back to identity when
    btoa/atob are absent. Provides no confidentiality.
  createAesGcmEncryptionProvider(options): Promise<EncryptionProvider | undefined>   (undefined when crypto.subtle is unavailable)
  createWebCryptoEncryptionProvider(key: CryptoKey): EncryptionProvider | undefined
    Output is Base64 of [12-byte random IV][ciphertext]. A fresh IV per value.
  deriveAesKey(password, salt, iterations = 250000): Promise<CryptoKey | undefined>
    PBKDF2-SHA256 -> AES-GCM-256, derived non-extractable.
  encryptRecordFields<T>(record, fields, provider): Promise<T>   (shallow copy; input never mutated)
  decryptRecordFields<T>(record, fields, provider, onFailure?): Promise<T>
  SECURITY NOTE: AES-GCM here is only as strong as where the key lives. A passphrase shipped in the same bundle
  protects a database dump, not the data from a reader of the page. Redaction (not encryption) is the library's
  privacy control; encryption is defence in depth for read access to the origin's storage.

## 6. PERSISTED RECORD SHAPES

ErrorRecord
  schemaVersion: 1; id: string; fingerprint: string;
  uploadStatus: 'pending'|'uploading'|'uploaded'|'failed'; uploadAttempts: number; claimedAt?: number;
  source: ErrorSource; severity: ErrorSeverity; category: ErrorCategory; handled: boolean; thrownType: ThrownType;
  name: string (<=1000); message: string (<=1000); stack?: string (<=8000);
  causes?: { name; message; stack? }[] (<=3); componentStack?: string (<=4000);
  location?: { source?; line?; column? }; api?: ApiErrorContext; event?: ErrorEventInfo;
  page: { url: string; route: string; pageLoadId: string };
  environment: { appName?; appVersion?; buildId?; environment?; userAgent?; platform?; viewport?; online?; visibilityState? };
  tags?: Record<string,string> (<=20, key<=50, value<=200);
  extra?: Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp: number; firstSeen: number; lastSeen: number; occurrenceCount: number (>=1)

LogRecord
  schemaVersion: 1; id: string; uploadStatus; uploadAttempts; claimedAt?;
  level: LogLevel; message: string (<=1000); data?: readonly unknown[] (<=5);
  route?: string (<=300, omitted when 'unknown'); pageLoadId: string;
  environment: { appName?; appVersion?; buildId?; environment? };
  timestamp: number; seq: number (per-page-load monotonic)

ErrorContext (caller side, all optional): source, severity, category, componentStack, location, api, event, tags, extra, handled, timestamp.
ApiErrorContext = { kind; method?; url? (sanitized); status?; statusText? (<=200); code?; timeout?; duration? (>=0); requestId? (<=200) }
ErrorEventInfo = { type: string; targetTag?; resourceUrl?; directive?; blockedURI?; crossOrigin? }
ErrorLocation = { source?; line?; column? }
ErrorCause = { name: string; message: string; stack?: string }
NormalizedError = { name; message; stack?; causes?; thrownType; isChunkError; isCrossOrigin; category?; aggregatedCount?; extra? }

## 7. STORAGE SCHEMA

DB 'rm-logvault-errors' (from `${dbPrefix}-errors`), version 1
  store 'errors', keyPath 'id'
  index 'by_fingerprint_status' on ['fingerprint','uploadStatus']
  index 'by_status' on 'uploadStatus'
DB 'rm-logvault-logs' (from `${dbPrefix}-logs`), version 1
  store 'logs', keyPath 'id'
  index 'by_status_timestamp' on ['uploadStatus','timestamp']
  index 'by_timestamp' on 'timestamp'

Cleanup runs on initialize() and every 25 (errors) / 200 (logs) successful writes, in chunks of 200 rows.
Quota failure => halve the cap, run cleanup, retry the same write exactly once.
DEFAULT_PENDING_LIMIT = 100. DEFAULT_OPEN_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000.
Malformed rows are DELETED on read, not returned.

STORAGE AVAILABILITY (no wrapper, no polyfill, no runtime dependency; uses globalThis.indexedDB directly)
  property missing / not an object / open not a function        -> reason 'unavailable'
  reading the property throws (browser refuses storage)         -> factory 'blocked', treated as 'unavailable'
  open() is bounded by DEFAULT_OPEN_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000           -> reason 'transaction' on timeout
  SecurityError on open                                          -> permanentlyUnavailable = true (no further retries)
  stale-connection names that drop the cached handle: InvalidStateError, DatabaseClosedError, AbortError,
    TransactionInactiveError; the next call reopens.
  versionchange -> close our handle so another tab's upgrade is not blocked; onclose -> drop cache;
    upgrade() is idempotent and re-runs after the database is deleted mid-session.
  StorageFailureReason = 'unavailable' | 'quota' | 'serialization' | 'transaction'
  StorageState         = 'initializing' | 'ready' | 'unavailable' | 'disabled'   (getTelemetryStatus().storage)
  'quota' names: QuotaExceededError, NS_ERROR_DOM_QUOTA_REACHED, legacy code === 22.  'serialization': DataCloneError.
  Each failure is reported once per stage through onInternalError as `storage (<reason>)`.
  BROWSER POLICY, NOT LIBRARY LIMITATION (docs/BROWSER-SUPPORT.md):
    - WebKit ITP deletes ALL script-writable storage (IndexedDB, localStorage, sessionStorage, service worker
      registrations and cache) after 7 days of browser use without user interaction on the site; web apps added to
      the home screen are exempt and keep their own counter. No API opts out of the cap.
    - Private/incognito: different quotas, data usually discarded when the session ends; some Safari versions refuse
      storage outright, throwing on property access or from open().
    - Firefox 103+ partitions IndexedDB by top-level site, on by default. Opaque origins (sandbox without
      allow-same-origin, data:, blob:) have no storage bucket and throw SecurityError.
    - Storage is best-effort; navigator.storage.persist() requests an eviction exemption (Firefox prompts,
      Chromium and WebKit decide silently). Firefox best-effort ceiling: min(10% of the volume, 10 GiB per-site group).
    - Default retention (errors 7 days, logs 3 days) sits inside Safari's 7-day cap, but the cap counts from last
      interaction, not from record age, so it can fire first.

## 8. UPLOAD STATE MACHINE

pending   --claimPending(limit, now)--> uploading  (uploadAttempts+1, claimedAt=now)
pending   --save() with a matching fingerprint--> merged in place (occurrenceCount++, min/max firstSeen/lastSeen)
uploading --2xx--> uploaded --delete(ids)--> row gone
uploading --terminal status--> failed
uploading --retryable / transport rejection / throwing getHeaders--> pending
uploading --requeueStale(CLAIM_LEASE_MS=300000, now)--> pending (claimedAt deleted)
failed    --retryFailedTelemetry()--> pending
pending|failed --cleanup(retentionDays, maxRecords)--> deleted

Aggregation never mutates an 'uploading' row.

## 9. REST CONTRACT

request: POST <errorsUrl|logsUrl>, Content-Type: application/json, credentials = rest.credentials (default 'same-origin'),
         redirect 'follow', abort after REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 10000, keepalive only on the unload flush when body < 60000 chars.
body: { schemaVersion: 1, kind: 'errors'|'logs', sentAt: epochMs,
        app: { appName, appVersion, buildId, environment },   // '' when not configured
        records: [ ...ErrorRecord | LogRecord ] }
response: only status and Retry-After are read. The body is NEVER read.

classification:
  2xx                                  -> ok        : delete(ids)
  400,401,403,404,405,410,413,415,422  -> terminal  : updateUploadStatus(ids,'failed') + onTerminalFailure(status, records)
  anything else non-2xx                -> retryable : updateUploadStatus(ids,'pending')
  network/abort/timeout/status 0       -> retryable : updateUploadStatus(ids,'pending')

backoff: min(15000 * 2^(failures-1), 900000) ms; the next delay is max(backoff, retryAfterMs).
steady interval after success: rest.intervalMs (30000).
first flush: FIRST_FLUSH_DELAY_MS = 5000 after start(); MAX_BATCHES_PER_FLUSH = 10; NOTIFY_DEBOUNCE_MS = 5000.
start() runs requeueStale(CLAIM_LEASE_MS) before scheduling and attaches an 'online' listener that schedules +5000.
Sync starts only after the storage readiness promise resolves true.
Delivery is AT LEAST ONCE. Idempotency key = record id. Duplicates must be tolerated.
The server must accept durably BEFORE returning 2xx, because the client deletes on 2xx.

endpoint validation (resolveEndpoint):
  reject: empty/whitespace; scheme javascript:|data:|vbscript:|file:|blob:|about:|chrome:|chrome-extension:
  relative URLs resolve against window.location.href; outside a browser they are unusable
  only http: and https: survive; requireHttps rejects http: unless hostname is localhost|127.0.0.1|::1|[::1]|0.0.0.0

idempotent write: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING (key on id, never on fingerprint).

## 10. REDACTION RULES (applied in this order)

1. URLs in free text (https?|blob) -> sanitizeUrlValue; data: -> 'data:[REDACTED]'
2. JWT: /\beyJ[\w-]{5,}\.[\w-]{5,}\.[\w-]*/g -> '[REDACTED]'
3. Auth schemes: /\b(Bearer|Basic|Token)\s+[\w.~+/=-]{6,}/gi -> '$1 [REDACTED]'
4. key=value secrets -> '$1[REDACTED]' with separators preserved
   token|access_token|refresh_token|id_token ; password|pwd|secret|client_secret ; api_key|api-key|apikey|session|sessionid ; phone|mobile|msisdn|telephone|email
5. Long opaque tokens with no key=value context: /(^|[^\w-])([\w-]{32,200})(?=[^\w-]|$)/g -> '$1[REDACTED]'
6. E-mail: /[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+(?:\.[\w-]+)+/g -> '[REDACTED]'
7. caller extraPatterns (win over everything above)
then truncate to maxLength, with the '…[truncated N]' suffix counted INSIDE the budget.

KNOWN LIMITATION: a bare short secret in prose is not detectable — sanitizeText('failed with hunter2')
keeps 'hunter2'. Use redaction.extraPatterns for a known value. Asserted by src/errors/sanitize.test.ts.

text is hard-truncated to HARD_TEXT_CAP = 20000 before any regex runs.

URL sanitisation:
  absolute -> rebuild `${protocol}//${host}` + sanitized path + redacted query (drops user:pass@)
  non-http(s) absolute -> `${scheme}[REDACTED]`; data: -> 'data:[REDACTED]'
  fragments dropped
  query: value kept only when the key is allow-listed (case-insensitive) AND not sensitive; kept values truncated to 100
  path segments: decoded segment that matches EMAIL_PATTERN, starts with 'eyJ', or matches /^[\w-]{32,}$/ -> '[REDACTED]'
  stack: STACK_QUERY_PATTERN /\?[^\s:)]*(?=:\d+(?::\d+)?)/g removed first

sensitive key check: key.toLowerCase().replace(/[-_\s]/g,'') tested against SENSITIVE_KEY_PATTERN; a sensitive KEY wins over the value.
isSensitiveKey fails closed (returns true if the test throws).
isAllowedQueryKey = allowedQueryParams.has(key.toLowerCase()) && !isSensitiveKey(key)

NEVER READ: request/response bodies, axios params/data, cookies, document.cookie, localStorage, sessionStorage,
            auth header values, form values, arbitrary headers (only the 4 correlation names are probed by name).

## 11. PERSIST LEVELS AND CONSOLE LEVELS (independent)

logs.level          = the PERSIST threshold  (default 'warn')
logger.setLevel(...) = the CONSOLE threshold (default 'warn')
Sinks run BEFORE the console filter. logger.setLevel('off') silences output while persistence continues.
Reserved prefixes are never persisted: [ErrorTracking], [LogTracking], [Telemetry], [DiagnosticsExport].
The internal console writer prefixes output with '[rm-logvault]'. console.* is allowed only in src/logger/consoleWriter.ts.
PRE_INIT_LOG_BUFFER_SIZE = 50; PRE_INIT_ERROR_BUFFER_SIZE = 50; LOG_FLUSH_BATCH_SIZE = 50; LOG_FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS = 1000.
All four are exported from the package root, as are ERROR_CLEANUP_EVERY_WRITES = 25 and
LOG_CLEANUP_EVERY_WRITES = 200, so the defaults are readable from the API rather than only from source.
NONE of them is an option (D-022). The two flush constants are the DEFAULTS of logs.writeFlushMs /
logs.writeBatchSize, which ARE options; the cleanup cadence is adjustable only by supplying your own
repository built with createErrorRepository/createLogRepository({ cleanupEveryWrites }); the pre-init
buffer cannot be an option because it fills before initTelemetry can be configured.
The first sink registered triggers replayPreInit().
captureConsole wraps only console.warn and console.error; first string arg = message, rest = data.

## 12. DIAGNOSTICS REPORT

shortcut default: Ctrl+Shift+Alt+D (key 'd', ctrl+shift+alt true, meta false), capture phase on document,
  ignored inside input/textarea/select/contenteditable, exact modifier match, allow() must return literal true.
  match order: all four modifiers (exact) -> event.code === 'KeyD' (event.key only as fallback) -> isEditableTarget
    -> allow() -> preventDefault(). Matching is on the PHYSICAL key because Alt+letter mangles event.key on
    AZERTY, Dvorak, AltGr and macOS Option layouts.
  REQUIRES A KEYBOARD: a phone or tablet never emits keydown, so the shortcut cannot fire there by construction.
    On touch devices call exportDiagnosticsReport() from a button. Nothing is installed when there is no document
    (SSR, prerender, worker), with shortcut:false, or before initTelemetry.
  onExported is NOT called on the early-return paths (in flight, !isBrowser(), repository === null); it IS called
    with false for a download or clipboard failure. "It never fired" therefore means either "did not match" or
    "returned early" — the two are distinguished only by isExportInFlight() and getTelemetryStatus().
filename: `${prefix}-${ISO with ':' and '.' -> '-'}.html|json`, prefix default 'diagnostics-report'.
export: returns false when !isBrowser(), repository === null (disabled or not initialized), or an export is
  already in flight, or the download cannot start. Storage 'unavailable' does NOT return false: the reads
  return {ok:false,reason:'unavailable'}, the file is still written with 0 records, and onInternalError receives
  'diagnostics-read-errors' / 'diagnostics-read-logs'. Disambiguate with getTelemetryStatus().storage.
  flushes first; reads getAll() on both repositories (all uploadStatus values);
  marshals in EXPORT_SLICE_SIZE = 500 slices with a setTimeout(0) yield;
  defers revokeObjectURL by 1000 ms (Safari cancels a synchronous revoke);
  copyToClipboard needs navigator.clipboard.writeText, else returns false (no silent fallback).
report HTML: <meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:">
  referrer no-referrer, robots noindex nofollow.
  records embedded once in <script type="application/json" id="diagnostics-data"> with < > & U+2028 U+2029 escaped as \uXXXX.
  viewer uses only textContent / createElement; never innerHTML; makes no network requests.
  privacy banner always present.
  viewer drill-down (no extra payload fields; all derived from the embedded records):
    page loads  : built once by joining errors on page.pageLoadId and logs on pageLoadId; each load gets a route,
                  a first/last timestamp, a span and error/log counts. Rows are ordered newest-first and clickable:
                  selecting a load filters BOTH the errors and the logs tables to it, and selecting the focused load
                  again clears the filter. That toggle is what makes the table the picker; there is no <select>.
    fingerprint : error rows are collapsed by fingerprint into one row each, with occurrenceCount summed across the
                  contributing rows (a 'pending' and a claimed row for one fingerprint are never merged in storage);
                  a collapsed group also shows a '<n> rows' pill.
    drill panel : id="drill". Shows the selected error's severity/name, its message, a meta list (fingerprint, page
                  load, route, first/last seen, occurrences, source, category, handled, upload status, plus request /
                  response / duration when api context exists), its stack, its raw JSON, and every log from the same
                  load ordered by timestamp with entries inside [firstSeen-5000, lastSeen+5000] highlighted (tr.near).
                  The empty state prompts the reader to select an error row.
    row counts  : errors-count reports fingerprints, logs-count and loads-count report rows vs totals.
    controls    : id="search" (message, name, source, category, fingerprint, api.url, pageLoadId, route),
                  id="severity", id="level".
    markup note : tr.sel marks the focused load row and the selected error row.
    viewer source lives in a TypeScript template literal, so it must never contain a backtick (a test asserts this),
                  and tsc cannot see it: five tests extract and execute the viewer against happy-dom.
The shortcut is OBSCURITY, NOT ACCESS CONTROL. Gate it with allow() if that is unacceptable.

## 13. EDGE CASES AND GUARANTEES

- captureError accepts null, undefined, primitives, Symbols, Proxies with throwing getters, circular cause graphs,
  AggregateErrors (5 sub-errors read), cross-realm Errors (structural typing, not instanceof).
- Identity dedup: a WeakSet remembers object/function errors so one Error reaching several paths is one record.
  Primitives are not tracked by identity; identical strings collapse by fingerprint instead.
- Re-entrancy guards: `capturing` (error pipeline), `busy` (logger dispatch), `replaying` (pre-init replay).
- Rate limiting: fixed 60s window; excess dropped; ONE summary line per rolled window; fails open.
- The dual-copy guard: state lives on globalThis[Symbol.for('logvault@1')] with a __logvaultState:true marker,
  defined non-writable/non-enumerable/non-configurable, so duplicate bundles share one installation.
- initTelemetry is idempotent; reconfiguration requires destroyTelemetry() first.
- Global handlers merge registrations and never overwrite a pre-existing window.onerror; cleanup restores it only
  while it is still ours, otherwise logVault stays installed but inert.
- clearTelemetryData() clears rows (store.clear()), clears the pre-init buffer, and returns false with no repository.
  It does NOT delete the databases and does NOT recall uploaded records.
- consent() is evaluated on error capture, on log persist, and at the top of every flush run
  (SyncManager.runFlush) before any network egress. Withdrawing consent therefore stops uploads of
  already-queued records; they stay 'pending' until consent returns or clearTelemetryData() erases them.
  A throwing consent gate fails closed.
- Every option numeric/level/array invalid value is ignored rather than applied.
- Offline: uploads are skipped when navigator.onLine is false, without counting a failure.
- Failure counters reset on success; retryFailedTelemetry() also clears the backoff.
- Nothing in the public API throws; every function that could fail returns a benign value instead.
- SSR/Node/worker: safe to import and call; nothing installs, nothing captures, nothing throws.
- Safari private mode: indexedDB access throws -> storage 'unavailable' -> console-only degradation. The report
  still downloads but contains 0 records. See docs/BROWSER-SUPPORT.md for the full policy matrix.
- The only network egress is createFetchTransport (or a caller-supplied transport). No beacons, no CDNs, no cookies.
